decisions.statement: A path the world names no page at is refused.
Putting the record in is left to the mechanical change of the same name.
`after` is handed on where the caller states `after`.
Where the caller states no `after`, the key the page's own type puts this one after is handed on.
That change is reached through the runner rather than by an import.
No record put in is resolved.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.
`after` is left out where the pages of this page's type write the key nowhere.

definition: one record put into one page property, judged by the checks a landing runs
